owner_report_2026_11_15_fourth.statement_summary: re-read all the code and always translate fully; in Ketmix, titles at different BPM were sped up with an odd cutting effect: no such effect; artist biographies must be translated; the new-release poster must not always be the same; artist pages must accept uploads by URL and keep them across versions; block/unblock/favourite an artist from a small menu under its circle in the search; the tab bar slider should become special when held (as on iOS); improve Ketmix copying Apple Music and Spotify.

ketmix.cause_of_the_effect: since 5.5.0 tempos up to 14-18 % apart were stretched, the common tempo rode during the blend and the incoming title glided back to its own speed in 16 steps afterwards; Media3 drains and flushes the processor chain at every playback-speed change, heard as small cuts
changes: no speed change while a deck is heard: the incoming speed is set once while silent, kept to the end of the title, reset to 1 at the next media item (not on repeat)
silent corrections stop 1.4 s before the deck is heard (audio buffer up to 1 s); a blend counts as heard after 12 % of its overlap
non-beatmatched plans use the outgoing deck's speed in their position mapping

new MixKind.Rise: resonant high-pass climb to 2.2 kHz, filtered noise up to 5 % of full scale, gain down to 78 %, soft clip, cut on a phrase with two beats of reverb; alternates with the echo; style 'Montée'
echo tail threshold from the measured last note, not from the announced duration
ketmix.never_run_with_real_audio: none of this was heard; the rise's levels are untuned

owner_section_changes: Studio: covers, artist photos and portraits can be given as HTTPS links on a public host (checked as an image, shown from their address, never stored).
Studio: an album-wide Canvas action also restores the titles of the album that had their own Canvas or had it off.
Overrides: album page titles linked to the page's album key; stale Canvas files and cached choices re-checked (see owner_report_2026_11_15_fourth).
known_limitations: Owner-section changes are deliberately not mentioned in the public release notes (owner preference).
A Canvas given as a link depends on the site that serves it: if it goes away or refuses streaming, nothing plays behind the title.
Ketmix needs the next title to be playable without a new resolution or one that succeeds in time; otherwise it says so and the title ends as before.
A manual skip is still a plain change of title: it is not mixed.
The mix journal is kept in memory only and is lost when the app is closed.

Ket 27 is an alpha: settings, switch, alerts, tab bar, colours and type follow iOS 27; page layouts elsewhere (Home, Library, album, player, sheets, menus) keep Ketvoice's own structure. No iPad sidebar, no minimised tab bar change, no new haptics.
Titles under 150 s and the light analysis setting get no body reading; 3:2 and 4:3 tempo relations between two different titles are still not mixed in time.
A title entered by a blend keeps the speed it was given (at most 4 % off its own) until it ends.
Blocking matches artist names; a blocked short name may also hide a group whose name contains it after a separator ("Fire" and "Earth, Wind & Fire").
Reading the body of two titles adds about 5 to 10 seconds of silent decoding before each new pair.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
